product_summary: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd (Kolkata-based forging company, listed on BSE/NSE) is a closed-die / hot forging manufacturer. Its publicly described product lines are: (1) forged auto components - crankshafts, steering knuckles, front axle beams, spindles, differential gears, transmission and driveline parts; (2) railway products - forged railway wheels, axles, wheel sets, bogie/railway components; (3) commercial vehicle and off-highway/tractor forgings; (4) oil & gas and power-sector forgings (flanges, valve bodies, pipeline components); (5) machined/heat-treated forged blanks. NOTE ON EVIDENCE: the company website (ramkrishnaforgings.com) returned only a JS bot-challenge page on every attempt, DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable (connection refused), and Wikipedia/BSE/Zauba/Screener/Tickertape were blocked or 404. Therefore the product list above is NOT corroborated by a page I could actually read in this session and must be treated as 'заявлено, не подтверждено' pending a manual check of the company's product pages and annual report. No customs line was available to me (out of scope per role).
comment: HS mapping vs declared 870899 / 871690: PARTIAL. 870899 (other parts & accessories of motor vehicles 8701-8705) is a genuine fit for the auto/off-highway forged parts line (axle beams, knuckles, spindles, gears) - exact for that segment. 871690 (parts of trailers/semi-trailers/other non-mechanically-propelled vehicles) is only a marginal fit: it covers trailer parts, whereas the bulk of the portfolio is passenger/commercial vehicle driveline and railway forgings, so this code looks like a narrow/incidental line rather than the core. MISSING from the declaration (industry misclassification risk): (a) 8607 / 86071900 - forged railway wheels, axles and wheel sets are a major declared business line of this company and are NOT covered by 870899 or 871690; (b) 8483 / 84831000 - crankshafts and transmission shafts, if shipped as separate shaft items rather than as vehicle parts; (c) 7326 / 73261990 - forged steel articles n.e.s., the correct residual heading for unmachined forged blanks and oil & gas / power forgings (flanges, valve bodies); (d) 7302 / 73023000 - railway track/switch components if supplied. The claimed industry label 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aviation & transport) is only half right: transport/automotive and railway are supported by the product lines, but there is no evidence of an aviation/aerospace product line in the material I could access - treat 'авиастроение' as unverified. Trader signs: none observed - the company presents itself as a forging manufacturer with its own plants, so role = manufacturer (not independently re-verified this session). Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, verdict accepted_hs_corrected - recommend correcting the declaration to add 86071900 (railway wheels/axles) and 73261990 (forged blanks/oil & gas), and keeping 870899 as the primary auto-parts code. All product attributions above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' because no readable primary source was reachable; no revenue, export volume, CIN or PAN data was researched or asserted (null).
